heading: Wisconsin Challenges Federal Rule on Business Ownership Reporting
summary: Wisconsin DOJ joined a lawsuit challenging changes to reporting under the Corporate Transparency Act. The law requires disclosure of who owns or controls certain businesses. The coalition says that information helps investigators trace money laundering and other financial crimes.

heading: Wisconsin Invites Students to Make Capitol Tree Ornaments
source: Wisconsin Department of Administration press release
summary: The governor's office announced that the 2026 Capitol holiday tree theme would be “The Year of the Neighbor.” It invited students to make ornaments that show what being a good neighbor means to them. The theme continues the governor's yearlong focus on recognizing Wisconsin neighbors.
